_doc: A bottle of the game's own booze (#1222, docs/briefs/booze.md): an amber beer quart with a blob top, its cork wired down (no crown caps until 1892). Its labels the brands of its shape (Riedl'S, Zeitler'S, Ebner'S, Fothergill'S, Twin Buttes, Wiener'S, Dr. Ferrell'S): the Nth made wears label N mod 7 (`variants`), or the one its dressing entry names (`variant`; tools/props/booze.py variant_of). A prop that shatters (GlassProp): a fall onto boards at 4.5 m/s or 60 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Drawn from glb:booze_bottles (tools/blender/props/booze.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, every label printed on one sheet (pbr:booze_labels), cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/booze.py.
